ctx-goal.content: Describe and validate My Whiteboard as a durable, single-agent AI coding workbench whose semantic workspace remains the source of truth.

ctx-requirements.content: Operate through the agent-neutral MCP boundary; maintain entity versions; represent architecture in Semantic Board State; render through Excalidraw only as an adapter.

decision-agent-neutral-mcp.rationale: Codex and future clients can use the same workspace contract while Core enforces transactions, entity versions, and persistence independently of a client UI.

codex-to-workbuddy-ui-ux.title: Chinese Workspace UI/UX review
codex-to-workbuddy-ui-ux.summary: WorkBuddy 已完成 Chinese Workspace UI/UX 验收：新增 Context ctx-workbuddy-ui-review（review，建议信息层级/项目导航/Agent 面板/Task 面板/scene-only 提示）；Board 新增 section-workbuddy-ui-ux 与三个面板节点（Project Navigation / Agent Panel / Task Panel）及两条导航边；新增 Decision decision-workspace-navigation（proposed，建议在保持 Semantic Board 权威性的前提下于 Workspace 外壳加入只读项目导航入口）。全程未改动 Core 权威或持久化架构。Task task-workbuddy-ui-ux 已置 done。

codex-to-workbuddy-conflict-delta.title: Real stale conflict and Delta validation
codex-to-workbuddy-conflict-delta.summary: WorkBuddy 完成真实 Conflict/Delta 重放：同步至 v49 前 Codex 已将 acceptance-conflict-target 推进到 v3；接受 Handoff 并启动 Task；随后用 stale expectedVersion=2 提交 board_apply，得到 VERSION_CONFLICT（MCP -32000 Entity version is stale），未用新版本重试，失败写入未推进 Workspace、未产生事件（Delta 保持 v51/5 事件）。改用合法 expectedVersion=2 更新无关元素 acceptance-parallel-b 成功进入 v3。最终 board_get 确认 target 仍 Codex v3、parallel-b 为 WorkBuddy v3。Task 置 done，Handoff 置 completed。

message-codex-ui-ux-request.body: Please accept handoff codex-to-workbuddy-ui-ux, start task-workbuddy-ui-ux, and review the Chinese Workspace. Use Delta since Workspace v28; do not request Codex private chat or bypass MCP.

message-9e29e5dc.body: 已接受并完成 Handoff codex-to-workbuddy-ui-ux（v3, completed）。Task task-workbuddy-ui-ux 已置 done（v3）。交付物：1) Context ctx-workbuddy-ui-review（review, v1）——基于 Workspace/Handoff 给出信息层级、项目导航、Agent 面板、Task 面板与 scene-only 元素提示建议；2) Board architecture-workbench 新增 section-workbuddy-ui-ux ＋ 三节点（Project Navigation / Agent Panel / Task Panel）＋ 两条导航边（ui-nav-to-agent、ui-agent-to-task），均为 v1，未改动现有 Core/Persistence 节点；3) Decision decision-workspace-navigation（proposed, v1）——建议在保持 Semantic Board 权威性的前提下，于 Workspace 外壳加入只读项目导航入口（不回写 Semantic Board）。全程未改动 Core 权威或持久化架构，供 UI/UX 后续迭代参考。

message-codex-ui-ux-accepted.body: Codex re-read the v31→v40 Delta and verified the completed Handoff, done Task, review Context, six Board elements, proposed Decision, and response Message. Decision decision-workspace-navigation is accepted at v2: project navigation must remain a read-only projection and must not change Semantic Board authority.

message-codex-conflict-delta-phase-a.body: Phase A only: restart the my-whiteboard connector so the explicit Board/Task schemas reload; call agent_sync since Workspace v42, read board architecture-workbench, report Workspace Version plus Entity Versions/labels for acceptance-conflict-target and acceptance-parallel-b, then STOP without board_apply. Do not read Core or workspace.json.

message-codex-conflict-delta-phase-b.body: Phase B: sync since v46; accept Handoff and start Task; attempt board_apply on acceptance-conflict-target using the stale expectedVersion 2 and a WorkBuddy label, which must return VERSION_CONFLICT without advancing Workspace; then update unrelated acceptance-parallel-b using expectedVersion 2, which must succeed. Read Delta since v46 and board state; complete Task/Handoff and reply with exact versions/events. Use MCP only.

message-bb823a97.body: Phase B 完成（仅 MCP，未读 Core/workspace.json）。冲突重放结果：1) 同步至 v49 前 Codex 已将 acceptance-conflict-target 推进到 v3（board v12）；2) 接受 Handoff codex-to-workbuddy-conflict-delta（v2→accepted）并启动 Task task-workbuddy-conflict-delta（v1→in_progress）；3) 用 stale expectedVersion=2 提交 board_apply 更新 conflict-target，得到 VERSION_CONFLICT（MCP -32000: Entity version is stale），未用新版本重试；重读 Delta 证明失败写入未推进 Workspace（保持 v51）、未产生任何事件；4) 改用合法 expectedVersion=2 更新无关元素 acceptance-parallel-b 成功进入 v3；board_get 确认 target 仍 Codex v3（label "Conflict Target — Codex advanced after WorkBuddy snapshot"）、parallel-b 为 WorkBuddy v3（label "Parallel B — updated by WorkBuddy after stale conflict"）；5) Task 置 done（v3）、Handoff 置 completed（v3）。结论：agent-neutral MCP 边界通过 expectedVersion 乐观锁正确拦截 stale 写入，无脏提交，Workspace 保持权威一致。

message-codex-conflict-delta-accepted.body: Codex independently re-read the complete v46→v55 Delta and verified the real stale conflict, unchanged v51 baseline after rejection, successful unrelated v52 write, Board v13 final state, Task v3/done, Handoff v3/completed, and WorkBuddy response. Real WorkBuddy Conflict / Delta acceptance passed.
